custom_expected: All 11 modal template descriptions match the canonical short strings exactly. Note: the modal short descriptions intentionally differ from the Roles list Description column copy (modal = action-oriented short pitch; list = polished sentence). Two distinct copy sources.
custom_preconds: On Roles list. Click 'Create custom role' to open the Choose a template modal.
custom_steps:
1. For each template visible in the modal, read the description line directly under the template name.
  2. Compare against the canonical short modal descriptions: Admin = 'Full system access'; Service Manager = 'Full operational access, limited admin'; Senior Service Advisor = 'Work order and customer management with expanded access'; Service Advisor = 'Work order and customer management with invoicing access'; Foreman = 'Oversees technicians and work orders'; Technician = 'Assigned work orders and time tracking'; Parts Manager = 'Full parts and inventory control'; Parts Tech = 'Parts operations and vendor management'; Office = 'Office administration, reporting, and back-office operations'; Sales Representative = 'Reports and financial data access only'; Time Clock = 'Clock in/out only'.
  3. Note the wording is DIFFERENT from the Roles list Description column (which uses longer, sentence-cased strings with terminal periods).
  4. File as a finding if any modal description does not match the canonical short string exactly.
title: Choose a template modal descriptions match the canonical short descriptions (different from Roles list descriptions)
